title: The opening cut from 123 s to 89 s by removing waits, not beats: the override at 54 s and the handover at 78
context: Owner, 2026-09-18: "everything must feel faster" in the opening. Measured on a bare page (scripts/browser-test.mjs --grow, which now marks landed, the breach, the first fodder and the first kill as well): Rotor 26.0 s, foundry beat 26.0-34.0, gate 34.0-49.2, tremor 50.8, breach 54.8, first fodder 55.7, override 83.4 (the player watched the pile for 27.7 s, the QA note of 2026-09-16), first kill 85.8, wave cleared 89.3, Quiver optic 95.7, handover 110.6, study 123.2, expedition 123.4. The target was the override under 55 s and the handover under 75 s with every beat kept readable.
outcome: Every wait the player only watches is now a content number, and shorter. New STORY_BEATS in src/content/story-defaults.js holds the beat clock that lived as defaults in src/domain/story-beats.js: faceDelays 4 -> 2.0, tremorDelay 1.5 -> 0.8, breachDelay 4 -> 2, the post-breach spawn pause 1 -> 0.4, overrideDelay 2.5 -> 1.5, and a new overrideCells 13 (the override waited for a body within 2.2 cells of the door, which is the entire march up the lane). STORY_FODDER.pace 1.7 lets a spawn carry its own march so the fifty surge instead of strolling. STORY_BREACH gains its own preRoll 0.7 (the shared immutable breach preset stays at 1.6 for the lab) and emergeHold 6 -> 3; the 1.4 s dive is untouched. BASE_BUILDER.cellsPerSecond 4.2 replaces the controller's ISAO_CELLS_SEC 2.6 - his flights cost more than his prints. base-programme seconds: gate 12 -> 6, landing 6 -> 4, Stalheart 18 -> 12 (the Quiver's order sat behind the Stalheart in Isao's FIFO for six seconds while the wave was being fought). FOUNDRY_TUNE.deployDelay 1.5 -> 0.7; the clip's own 15 s to the first barrel is the floor under the Rotor and is untouched. STORY_QUIVER delay 0.6 -> 0.3, secondDelay 9 -> 3, studyDelay 3 -> 1.5. Measured after: Rotor 22.5, foundry beat 22.5-29.0, gate 29.0-36.9, tremor 37.8, breach 39.8, first fodder 40.3, override 54.4, first kill 56.0, wave cleared 63.2, Quiver optic 64.4, handover 77.7, study 88.7, expedition 89.0. src/td-tab.js is net zero lines (three in-place edits). Two --story-world steps were retimed because they measured the old opening rather than what they assert: the Rotor heat peak read whatever the harness's ten kills cost in rounds (halved to 0.037 with the swarm bunched mid-lane) and now fires the two-second burst the assertion names, reading 0.19 against the same threshold; and the post-clear enemies===0 became 'no white amoeba left', because the Quiver's first hard core now rises a third of a second after `cleared`.
alternatives: Cutting the shared breach preset's preRoll 1.6 directly: rejected, the shipped FX package is immutable and the breach lab shares it. The story carries its own preRoll instead.
Cutting the foundry clip's 15 s to the first barrel: rejected, the cue times are authored into assets/models/story/arrival-foundry-manifest.json and the clip would desync.
Lowering the Rotor heat threshold to match the new reading: rejected as weakening an assertion; the measurement was retimed instead.

Speeding the swarm alone (STORY_FODDER.pace) was measured not to be the cause of the heat drop: the peak stayed at 0.037 with pace back at 1.0, which located the cause in when the seat is handed over, not how fast the fodder move.

Cutting the handover further to the 75 s target: not done. The 13.3 s from the Quiver optic to `settled` is the two hard cores being fought, and the 7.2 s before that is the fifty being killed. That is play, not waiting.
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --grow: before at ad201a08, after at fbeadcdc; the GROW marks are the two tables above
scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: green (rotor heat peak 0.1891 over 907 frames)
scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --quiver-frame: green, launch to ignite 152 of 152 in frame

npm test (120 test programs) and npm run check green at each commit; test/story-beats.mjs covers overrideCells, spawnDelay and the swarm's pace, and test/build-programme.mjs floors every print at 4 s and caps the gate at 9
The heat regression was bisected against ad201a08 in the same worktree: main 0.0731, the branch 0.0371, both deterministic across two runs
